paperTitleZh: 化學 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 丙部 分析化學
paperTitle: Chemistry Mock — Paper 2 Section C Analytical Chemistry

parts.label: a(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 有兩瓶失去標籤的白色固體，分別是碳酸鉀和碳酸鈣。寫出利用焰色試驗辨別兩者的預期觀察。
parts.questionTextEn: Two bottles of white solid have lost their labels. They are potassium carbonate and calcium carbonate. State the expected observations that distinguish them using a flame test.

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 無水碳酸鈉可用作基本標準物。寫出這物質所具有的一項性質，令它適合作基本標準物。
parts.questionTextEn: Anhydrous sodium carbonate can be used as a primary standard. State one property that makes it suitable.

parts.label: a(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 以己烷從碘水中萃取碘。根據碘的溶解度及己烷的性質，解釋這液-液萃取法的原理。
parts.questionTextEn: Iodine is extracted from iodine solution in water using hexane. In terms of the solubility of iodine and the properties of hexane, explain the principle of this liquid-liquid extraction.

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼這滴定不需加入指示劑。
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why no indicator needs to be added in this titration.

parts.label: b(ii1)
parts.questionTextZh: 寫出終點時的顏色變化。
parts.questionTextEn: State the colour change at the end point.

parts.label: b(ii2)
parts.questionTextZh: 計算消毒藥水中過氧化氫的濃度（以 $\text{g dm}^{-3}$ 為單位）。（相對分子質量：$\mathrm{H_2O_2}$ = 34.0）
parts.questionTextEn: Calculate the concentration of hydrogen peroxide in the disinfectant, in $\text{g dm}^{-3}$. (Relative molecular mass: $\mathrm{H_2O_2}$ = 34.0)

parts.label: b(ii3)
parts.questionTextZh: 品質控制標準要求實際濃度與標示值相差不多於 ±5%。通過計算，確定這批消毒藥水是否合格。
parts.questionTextEn: The quality control standards require the actual concentration to be within ±5% of the labelled value. By calculation, determine whether this batch of disinfectant passes.

parts.label: b(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼用硫酸而不用氫氯酸酸化。
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why sulphuric acid rather than hydrochloric acid is used to acidify the solution.

parts.label: c(i1)
parts.questionTextZh: 推定 T 的分子式。（相對原子質量：H = 1.0，C = 12.0，O = 16.0）
parts.questionTextEn: Deduce the molecular formula of T. (Relative atomic masses: H = 1.0, C = 12.0, O = 16.0)

parts.label: c(i2)
parts.questionTextZh: 參照 m/z 45 的基峰，並指出圖中沒有哪一個峰，推定 T 的結構式。
parts.questionTextEn: With reference to the base peak at m/z 45, and by stating which peak is absent from the diagram, deduce the structural formula of T.

parts.label: c(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 把 T 與酸化重鉻酸鉀溶液一同加熱。寫出預期的觀察。
parts.questionTextEn: T is heated with acidified potassium dichromate solution. State the expected observation.

parts.label: c(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 由 (c)(ii) 的反應分離出有機生成物 V。寫出 V 的結構式，並解釋為什麼 V 不是羧酸。
parts.questionTextEn: The organic product V is separated from the reaction in (c)(ii). Write the structural formula of V, and explain why V is not a carboxylic acid.

parts.label: c(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: 已知 C=O 的紅外吸收波數域為 $1680$–$1800\ \text{cm}^{-1}$，醇的 O–H 為 $3230$–$3670\ \text{cm}^{-1}$（闊峰）。解釋如何比較 T 和 V 的紅外光譜，以確定 T 已完全轉化。
parts.questionTextEn: Given that the infra-red absorption wavenumber ranges are $1680$–$1800\ \text{cm}^{-1}$ for C=O and $3230$–$3670\ \text{cm}^{-1}$ (broad) for O–H in alcohols, explain how the IR spectra of T and V can be compared to show that T has been completely converted.
